title: 도시 생활 이야기: 사람도 많고, 교통도 편리해요
objective: By the end, you can use words like 인구, 복잡하다, 발달하다, 시설 and 교통 in short sentences to compare life in a city with life in the countryside.
summary: Learn 10 words for describing city and country life, such as population, crowds, transportation and facilities.

task.title: Use the city words
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose, write or change a word from the word list so the sentence makes sense.

words.example: 저는 큰 도시보다 작은 도시가 살기 좋아요.
words.exampleMeaning: I find small cities better to live in than big cities.

words.meaning: population (number of people living in a place)
words.exampleMeaning: Seoul is a city with a large population.

words.meaning: to be crowded, busy (with people or cars)
words.exampleMeaning: The subway is really crowded at rush hour.

words.meaning: to be well developed, to become advanced
words.example: 인터넷이 발달해서 집에서도 쇼핑할 수 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The internet is so advanced that you can shop from home.

words.example: 새 아파트라서 주차장, 놀이터 같은 시설이 좋아요.
words.exampleMeaning: It is a new apartment, so the facilities, like the parking lot and playground, are good.

words.example: 회사까지 교통이 불편해서 버스를 두 번 갈아타요.
words.exampleMeaning: Getting to work is inconvenient, so I change buses twice.

words.example: 집 앞에 편의점이 있어서 정말 편리해요.
words.exampleMeaning: There is a convenience store in front of my house, so it is really convenient.

words.example: 나중에 은퇴하면 시골에 가서 살고 싶어요.
words.exampleMeaning: When I retire, I want to go and live in the countryside.

words.meaning: to increase, to grow in number
words.example: 요즘 혼자 사는 사람이 많이 늘었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: These days, the number of people living alone has grown a lot.

words.example: 공원이 많아서 아이들을 키우기 좋은 환경이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: There are many parks, so it is a good place to raise children.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 이 도시는 지하철이 잘 (발달해서 / 복잡해서) 차가 없어도 괜찮아요. ② 집 근처에 지하철역이 있어서 (편리해요 / 복잡해요).
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 우리 고향은 젊은 사람들이 떠나서 ____이/가 계속 줄고 있어요.
Write the opposite word from the list: ① 도시 ↔ ____ ② 줄다 ↔ ____
Read and answer in Korean with a word from the list: 이 동네에는 수영장, 체육관, 도서관이 다 있어요. 이 동네에는 무엇이 많아요?

Fill in the blank. For ①, change the word in brackets to the -아요/어요 form. For ② and ③, write a noun from the list: ① 명절 전에는 시장이 사람들로 ____. (복잡하다) ② 이 동네는 ____이 좋아서 버스로 어디든 갈 수 있어요. ③ 공장이 많아지면 ____이 나빠져요.
answers: ① 복잡해요 ② 교통 ③ 환경
